author: Vishal Bakhai
description:
This was the first time F-Droid had an official presence at IndiaFOSS, and I honestly did not know what to expect.

We actually had quite a lot of people coming by. Most were students, and many had never heard of F-Droid before. That made it a different experience.

A lot of the conversations started with the basics. What is F-Droid? Why would someone use it? How does it work? Can I put my app on it? Are there any subscription charges like apps on Play store?

Some people stayed and talked for a while. Some came back later with friends. Quite a few came up just to say that they were glad F-Droid was there. That last part was probably the nicest surprise.

People were also asking how they could help. We need that. F-Droid needs developers, but we also need testers and people willing to spend time using things, finding problems and reporting them properly.
